scheme_name: MMKY-Financial Assistance for New Boat, Engine, and Net
other_conditions: Must be a resident of Odisha.
Must possess identity and residential proof, including a QR‑coded Aadhaar Card.
Must have a bank account in the applicant’s name in Odisha.
Must not have received any financial assistance for a new boat or engine after 1 April 2018 (last 5 years) or for a fishing net after 1 April 2020 (last 3 years).
Only one benefit per family is allowed; if any family member received a subsidy in the last three years, the family is ineligible.
Only one unit (boat with engine and net) is allowed per individual beneficiary.
Procurement of a fishing boat is mandatory; engine and net are optional.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹4 lakh subsidy (40% for General, 60% for SC/ST/Women/PWD/Transgender) on a new fishing boat, with optional engine and net support.
documents_required: Bank account statement or passbook in the applicant’s name
